files.name: motion-prompt-067.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Mega menu" (メガメニュー), one of the names in "UI component names".
Motion Prompt #067

What it is: A wide panel of grouped links that opens from the main menu
What the sample shows: Hovering over "Products" in the header drops a full-width panel with three columns of links and an image; it closes when the cursor leaves.
Spec:
- 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. A 42-tall header with "Products, Pricing, Support" (in Japanese, 16 px, each with a down chevron).
- The cursor only hovers: it reaches "Products" at 1.0 s. Open amount a: 0→1 over 1.05–1.3 s with easeOutCubic; "Products" turns blue with an underline.
- Panel: white, full width, 146 tall, dropping 12 px into place under the header while fading in with a. Shadow blur 18, offset y 8.
- Inside: three columns 130 px apart (a blue heading and three links each) and a 104×112 picture at the right. The cursor moves down and the second link of the second column is highlighted light blue from 1.75 to 2.9 s.
- Close: the cursor leaves the panel from 2.9 s; it fades over 3.15–3.4 s (1 − easeInOutCubic).
When to use it: Use it on sites with many products or sections so visitors can see the whole range at once.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/067.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/ui.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
